WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT complaint_id,
           date_complaint_raised AS dt,
           date_complaint_closed AS end_dt
    FROM Complaints
    WHERE date_complaint_closed >= date_complaint_raised
    UNION ALL
    SELECT complaint_id,
           date(dt, '+1 day'),
           end_dt
    FROM date_range
    WHERE dt < end_dt
)
SELECT AVG(business_days) AS avg_business_day_resolution_time
FROM (
    SELECT complaint_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%w', dt) NOT IN ('0','6') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS business_days
    FROM date_range
    GROUP BY complaint_id
);

        UNION ALL
        SELECT complaint_id, staff_id,
               date(d, '+1 day'),
               offset + 1

questions.nlq: Could you tell me the average number of days to close a complaint for all staff members who have been assigned more than the median number of Hardware product complaints?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: I mean the single overall average duration computed across all those staff members together.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH hardware_staff_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.staff_id,
        COUNT(*) as hardware_complaint_count
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_category_code = 'Hardware'
    GROUP BY c.staff_id
),
ranked_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        hardware_complaint_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY hardware_complaint_count) as row_num,
        COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count
    FROM hardware_staff_counts
),
median_calculation AS (
    SELECT AVG(hardware_complaint_count) as median_value
    FROM ranked_counts
    WHERE row_num IN ((total_count + 1) / 2, (total_count + 2) / 2)
),
qualifying_staff AS (
    SELECT hsc.staff_id
    FROM hardware_staff_counts hsc
    CROSS JOIN median_calculation mc
    WHERE hsc.hardware_complaint_count > mc.median_value
)
SELECT AVG(
    julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised)
) as avg_days_to_close
FROM Complaints c
WHERE c.staff_id IN (SELECT staff_id FROM qualifying_staff);
